theme.description: Blueprint Chameleon™: cinematic dark UI, glassmorphism, NO white backgrounds.

layout.spacing: tight to generous depending on component
layout.grids: asymmetrical and bento style when possible

components.knowledge_strip: Sticky top bar, blur backdrop, key metrics.
components.future_uses_panel: Highlights ecosystem availability. State A (existing uses) active glow, State B (available uses) discrete chips.
components.knowledge_impact_card: AI Validation ROI module. Cyan glow delta animations.
components.connected_assets_network: SVG 4-quadrant mini-graph replacing static lists. Thumbnails on nodes.
components.post_certification_launch: Hero large tiles, directional arrows, runway layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure HTML layout is built without generic white backgrounds. Embrace the glassmorphism and cyan glows as specified in v2 and v3. Implement animations for AI Validation impact and Future Uses states.
